Watch on YouTube

Lineup

  6. If This Isn’t Love (Burton Lane; lyr. E.Y. Harburg)
  7. Patrick Bartley, alto saxophonist, takes the stage
  8. How High the Moon (Morgan Lewis; lyr. Nancy Hamilton)
  9. Love for Sale (Cole Porter)
  10. Come Sunday (Duke Ellington)
  11. Black Caesar (orig. comp. Russell Hall)
  12. My Favorite Things (Richard Rodgers; lyr. O. Hammerstein)
  13. Satin Doll (Duke Ellington, Billy Strayhorn; lyr. Johnny Mercer)
